question: reporting chain from a TEC engineer up to CEO
response:
Here's the reporting chain from a TEC engineer up to CEO, using **TEC-MOB (Mobile)** as an example since it has the clearest chain at every level:

---

### 📊 Reporting Chain: TEC Engineer → CEO

| Level | Role | Person | Contact |
|---|---|---|---|
| **IC** | Mobile Software Engineer | *(e.g. an engineer in TEC-MOB)* | — |
| **Lead** | Lead Mobile Software Engineer | **อภิชัย กิตติพงศ์** (Apichai / กุ้ง) | APICHAI.KI@fahmai.co.th |
| **Manager** | Manager Mobile Software Engineer | **แหวน ใจเขียววัฒน์** (Waen) | WAEN.JA@fahmai.co.th |
| **Director** | Director Mobile Software Engineer | **กานติมา ใจเขียวชัย** (Kantima) | ✆ 71216 / KANTIMA.JA@fahmai.co.th |
| **VP** | VP Technology | **ณัฐพงษ์ อธิดี** (Nattaphong) | ✆ 75793 / NATTAPHONG.AT@fahmai.co.th |
| **C-level** | Chief Technology Officer | **ฤทธิชัย แก้วใสภิญโญ** (Rittichai / ปันปัน) | ✆ 75477 / RITTICHAI.KA@fahmai.co.th |
| **C-level** | Chief Executive Officer | **วชิร จิรบุญ** (Vachir / เบอร์รี่) | ✆ 73048 / VACHIR.CH@fahmai.co.th |

---

### 🗺️ Structure Summary

TEC has **two VP tracks** under the CTO:

- **TECVP** (ณัฐพงษ์ อธิดี, VP Technology) — oversees MOB, FE, QA, SEC, DATA, DS sections
- **TECPM** (ราชตะ สัมชาญณรงค์, VP Platform) — oversees PLT section

Both VPs report to **CTO ฤทธิชัย แก้วใสภิญโญ**, who reports to **CEO วชิร จิรบุญ**.

Not every section has all four middle layers (Lead/Manager/Director) — MOB has the full stack. Other sections like SEC or DS skip Manager and go Lead → Director → VP.
